bullets.text: cut grass and woodsmoke on the road to tanema-ji. nobody around to claim either smell.
duck stood at tanema-ji, carrying a borrowed line about mysterious ways. the cedars didn't ask for an explanation. ❂
still fighting a zipper that broke around the third temple. losing, slowly, with dignity.
quietly stubborn today. the useful kind.
the mysterious way and the muddy one turn out to be the same width.
